result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Manage static route aliases for Docker/external services

USAGE:
    Portless.Cli.dll alias <NAME> [PORT] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    Portless.Cli.dll alias db 5432
    Portless.Cli.dll alias --remove db

ARGUMENTS:
    <NAME>    The name for the alias (e.g. 'db', 'redis')
    [PORT]    The target port number                     

OPTIONS:
                         DEFAULT                                                
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
        --remove                      Remove an existing alias                  
        --host           localhost    Target host (default: localhost)          
        --protocol       http         Backend protocol (http or https)          
    -p, --path <PATH>                 Path prefix for path-based routing (e.g.  
                                      /api)
